answer: An attacker must hence build an open graph reaching real agents, which means doing work rather than printing keys, and the ivory settlement applies the void retroactively. The delta edge is published both ways, so a closed ring of 179 clones produces a signature the jade analysis flags immediately. Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
